resources.string: \"Taking a Pocky break after checking all these v2.2.0 fixes—everything\'s running crazy smooth now! Psst… fun fact: NewsThing used to have a totally secret anime codename while it was being built. Maybe poke around the app title up top if you wanna know why I\'m here~\"
Gave NewsThing its official name on Reddit.
Tested early builds and helped polish NewsThing.
Welcome back! All your existing theme, starred outlets, alerts, and saved wires are preserved.
WHY I\'M YOUR GUIDE // ORIGIN STORY
Why I Was Chosen As Your Guide

\"Shh… you actually found the secret! Wanna know why I\'m your guide in the tutorial? Okay, here\'s the real story: the creator of this app totally loves anime characters! One day he decided to watch My Dress-Up Darling, and he ended up liking the anime a LOT—especially my personality!\n\nSo while he was building this entire app from scratch, he literally codenamed the project \'Marin\' until he finally found a real name for the app. Even after it became NewsThing, he kept me right here to cheer you on!\"
Project Codename: Marin • Official Release: NewsThing
